common.tagline: Red-skied haunted world of the Nightsister witches.
hyperlanes: Off-lane spur from the Quelii sector
common.famousFor: Nightsister magicks, rancor herds, and a planetary mood that drives spacers to the bottle.
common.cantinaReputation: Mysterious world shrouded in red mist. Home to the Nightsisters — Force-wielding witches who survived the Clone Wars purge. In 15 BBY, Dathomir is avoided by anyone with sense. Dense forests, hostile wildlife, and dark side energy make it a last-resort landing site.
